# Equireel

> Equireel is an equine media company filming eventing (horse trials) cross
> country in the United Kingdom, Ireland, France and the USA. Riders buy
> professionally edited videos of their own cross country round — filmed at
> every fence, edited with their choice of music, country flag and options,
> and delivered by email, typically within 5 days and often much sooner.

## What a visitor (or agent acting for a rider) can do here

- Search any horse, rider or bib number from the homepage search.
- Browse events by country: /events?country=gb (UK), ie (Ireland), fr (France),
  us (USA), be (Belgium).
- Every competitor at a filmed event is listed — no pre-booking is needed.
  If Equireel filmed the event, the rider's round exists.
- See which upcoming events Equireel is filming: /calendar ("Where we'll
  be"). Riders can leave an email there to be told when their event's
  videos go on sale.
- Watch a free sample round on every horse page before buying.
- Order in about a minute: pick the horse page, choose add-ons, pay by card,
  Apple Pay or Google Pay (Stripe). No account needed.

## Products and pricing

- Cross Country Video: £60 (UK), €70 (Europe), $159 (USA)
- Social Reel add-on (portrait edit for Instagram/TikTok): +£10 / +€10 / +$20
- Show Jumping add-on: +£20 / +€20 / +$20
- Show Jumping video alone: £30 / €30 / $40
- Single fence video: £25 / €25 / $35
- DVD copy posted: +£5

Every video is made to order: rider's choice of country flag, music on/off,
course sounds on/off, faults included or excluded, public or private.

## Key pages

- Homepage and search: /
- Filming calendar (upcoming events): /calendar
- How it works and FAQ: /faq
- Terms (delivery, refunds): /terms
- Privacy: /privacy

## Facts agents can rely on

- Delivery: by email, within 5 days (many events within the hour or instant).
- Refunds: full refund any time before delivery; withdrew before cross
  country = full refund or credit; eliminated on course = partial footage or
  refund; free edit requests after delivery.
- Contact: info@equireel.com (a human reads it).
